title: The 4 Types of AI Coding Agent Loops Explained
description:
Anthropic's Claude Code team broke down 4 loop types for automating coding tasks: turn based, goal based, time based, and proactive.
Each hands off more control to the agent, with its own risks.
Follow for daily AI news.
